dialog: The land itself is losing life.
Would you happen to have some spring with you?
If I can't find spring in time...
I need to do my best!
I should attack first/ once in a while.
I'll do anything to bring spring back!
Oh/ I'm supposed to fight back/ right?
If you attack me/ I attack you back. It's common courtesy!
At least I saw it coming...
Sorry. I don't have any spring...
You missed...\n　Did you do that on purpose?
No... Not when spring is so close...
Forgive me.\n　I couldn't find spring.
I need to do my best!
I should attack first/ once in a while.
Oh/ I'm supposed to fight back/ right?
If you attack me/ I attack you back. It's common courtesy!
Let it be known—A spring breeze is coming!
I'm trying my best just to dodge!
Hmmm... Nope/ nothing I can do from here.
Oh/ I think I can attack too!
I can help you out/ at least!
I know I'm weak/ but there's still something I can do!
If things go bad/ I'll heal you right away.
The least I can do is help!
We're one step closer to spring!
We're one step closer to spring!
Oh/ I think I can attack too!
I won't forget what you've done for me/ Rabbit!
Together we can do anything/ Rabbit!
Rabbit and I are here to announce spring!
This is the power of sleeping life!
Even if we're from different seasons/ we can still be friends!
Even if we're from different seasons/ we can still be friends!
This is the power of sleeping life!
Even if we're from different seasons/ we can still be friends!
Even if we're from different seasons/ we can still be friends!
I can sense all of the danmaku...
I bet I look like an easy mark...
I should have tried to dodge the other way...
Do I actually stand out that much?
At least I braced for it in time...
You missed...\n　Did you do that on purpose?
Why are you focusing on me?!
The power of spring protects me!
Uhm/ would you mind if I attacked first?
I'm sorry...\n　I'll go rest in the back for a while.
Forgive me...\n　I can't keep going any longer.
If you don't stop/ the land will be in trouble!\n　There might not even be spring anymore!
God of the sun/ please give Utsuho back!
Please/ let us through! We don't want to hurt you!
I had no idea you were so strong/ Mehko!
Mehko/ I'm begging you... Stop it.
Once this is done/ I can finally announce the arrival of spring.
Makura/ wouldn't you like to get to know us better?
I want to announce the arrival of spring in Gensokyo to you as well!
